selection: The 34 candidate_url_id values in the v6 export but absent from the corrected September 10 baseline
method: Read each selected claim's source_content_path from the droplet ledger. Decompress the saved gzip and compare SHA256 with source_content_sha256.
limitation: Hash agreement establishes saved-source integrity, not correctness of campaign ownership, office, or election-year attribution. V7 may exclude some selected claims.
